questions.prompt: What primarily causes the rapid depolarization phase (upstroke) of a neuronal action potential?
options: Influx of sodium ions (Na+) through voltage-gated channels
Activation of the Na+/K+ ATPase pump
questions.explanation: Once threshold is reached, voltage-gated Na+ channels rapidly open, allowing Na+ to rush down its electrochemical gradient into the cell.

questions.prompt: In the nephron, where does the majority of filtered water, sodium, and 100% of filtered glucose get reabsorbed?
questions.explanation: The proximal convoluted tubule reabsorbs ~65% of water and electrolytes and virtually all glucose via SGLT transporters.
